# Checkbox: `jl-checkbox`

A box to tick, with its label beside it.

- Class `JlCheckbox`, an atom: `import { JlCheckbox } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/checkbox

A box to tick for a yes or no that is confirmed later, with a button: accept the terms, choose the
columns to export. For a setting that applies at once, prefer a switch.

It takes part in forms like a native checkbox: while checked, the form gets its value ("on" unless set), and with
required the form cannot be submitted until it is checked. Clicking the label toggles it too. indeterminate draws a
dash, for a box that stands for a list whose items are partly checked; the next click decides.

## Use

```ts
import { JlCheckbox } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlCheckbox
  description="About once a month, never more."
  label="Email me about new releases"
/>
```

```html
<jl-checkbox
  description="About once a month, never more."
  label="Email me about new releases"
></jl-checkbox>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `checked` (attribute `checked`): `boolean`, default `false`. Whether the box is ticked. The attribute is also what a form reset goes back to.
- `indeterminate` (attribute `indeterminate`): `boolean`, default `false`. Draws a dash: neither checked nor unchecked, until the next click.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The text beside the box.
- `description` (attribute `description`): `string`, default `''`. A smaller line under the label.
- `value` (attribute `value`): `string`, default `'on'`. What the form gets while the box is checked.
- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. The field's name in the form's data.
- `required` (attribute `required`): `boolean`, default `false`. The form cannot be submitted until it is checked.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. Cannot be changed or focused.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `boolean`: Someone checked or unchecked the box.

## Slots

- The default slot: A richer label, with a link or emphasis.

## Methods

- `toggle(): void`: Flips the state, as a click would, and fires change.
- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the box.
- `checkValidity(): boolean`: Whether a required box is checked.
- `reportValidity(): boolean`: The same check; when it fails, the browser shows its message on the control.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The label around the box and its text.
- `--box` (custom property): The size of the box (18px).

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### States

```html
<div class="stack">
  <jl-checkbox label="Unchecked"></jl-checkbox>
  <jl-checkbox label="Checked" checked></jl-checkbox>
  <jl-checkbox label="Indeterminate" indeterminate></jl-checkbox>
  <jl-checkbox label="Disabled" disabled></jl-checkbox>
  <jl-checkbox label="Disabled and checked" disabled checked></jl-checkbox>
</div>
```

### With a description

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-checkbox
    label="Weekly digest"
    description="A summary of the activity in your projects, every Monday."
    checked
  ></jl-checkbox>
  <jl-checkbox
    label="Product news"
    description="New features and improvements, about once a month."
  ></jl-checkbox>
</div>
```

### Rich label

The default slot takes a label with a link or emphasis.

```html
<jl-checkbox required>
  I accept the <a href="#/components/checkbox">terms of service</a>
</jl-checkbox>
```

### Select all

The parent box is indeterminate while only some of its items are checked.

```html
<div class="stack demo-all">
  <jl-checkbox class="parent" label="All columns"></jl-checkbox>
  <div class="stack" style="padding-left: 28px">
    <jl-checkbox class="child" label="Name" checked></jl-checkbox>
    <jl-checkbox class="child" label="Email"></jl-checkbox>
    <jl-checkbox class="child" label="Last seen"></jl-checkbox>
  </div>
</div>
```

```js
const parent = root.querySelector('.parent');
const children = [...root.querySelectorAll('.child')];
const sync = () => {
  const checked = children.filter((child) => child.checked.get()).length;
  parent.checked.set(checked === children.length);
  parent.indeterminate.set(checked > 0 && checked < children.length);
};
parent.events.register('change', (checked) => {
  for (const child of children) child.checked.set(checked);
});
for (const child of children) child.events.register('change', sync);
sync();
```
